title: The teammate upstream
brief:
This repository is a clone: `git remote -v` shows where it came from. While you were offline, your teammate pushed a commit to origin.

Nothing in your repository knows about it yet. Your `origin/main` is a local cache of what the remote looked like the last time you talked to it. Refresh the cache.

goals.label: origin/main knows about the teammate's commit

hints: git fetch talks to origin and refreshes your origin/* refs. It never moves your branches.
Type git fetch, then watch the graph: origin/main jumps while main stays put.
